scope: Source inventory only; route existence and generic workflow review do not imply native business completion.

limitations: 96KiB serialized request limit including fields and base64 attachments; three files maximum; no large-file upload implementation
source observations verify stored JSON bytes, not external file integrity or native approval
handoffs follow declared next edges, currently within processes; cross-case canonical WP bindings require separate implementation/acceptance
existing home procedure queues do not yet aggregate case-specific review/receipt tasks
ALM/P13 resolver requires their own source migrations and integration tests
